name: Gästehaus Obwexer
beschreibung:
Peacefully located in the mountaineering village of Matrei in Osttirol, Gaestehaus Obwexer provides a welcoming haven for hikers. Traditional wood furnishings and scenic vistas create a soothing ambiance.

The Grossglockner Resort Kals-Matrei ski lifts and pristine Hohe Tauern alpine trails start close by.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Obwexer in Matrei in Osttirol offers nature holidays in the Hohe Tauern National Park.
